title: Strengthening Family Stability
learningGoal: Build long-term stability through predictable routines and emotional safety.
microLesson: Stability grows from consistent routines, calm communication, and predictable caregiver responses.
activity: List three stability-building actions you will focus on this week.

title: Helping Children Build Resilience
learningGoal: Support children in developing resilience after DFV-related stress.
microLesson: Resilience grows through connection, emotional literacy, and supportive caregiver presence.
activity: Identify one resilience skill your child is developing and describe how you support it.

title: Repairing Emotional Ruptures
learningGoal: Learn how to repair emotional ruptures and rebuild trust.
microLesson: Repair involves acknowledging feelings, offering reassurance, and reconnecting with warmth.
activity: Use the repair script to complete a short repair conversation.

title: Strengthening Positive Parenting
learningGoal: Develop positive parenting strategies that support emotional safety.
microLesson: Positive parenting uses warmth, clear expectations, and calm correction to build trust.
activity: Write three positive parenting strategies you will practice this week.

title: Creating a Supportive Home Environment
learningGoal: Reduce stressors and create a supportive home environment.
microLesson: A supportive environment includes calm spaces, predictable routines, and emotional availability.
activity: Identify one environmental stressor and create a reduction plan.

title: Caregiver Wellbeing and Balance
learningGoal: Strengthen caregiver wellbeing to support long-term family stability.
microLesson: Caregiver wellbeing affects emotional availability, patience, and consistency. Small self-care actions matter.
activity: Write a short wellbeing plan for the next week.

title: Weekly Reflection and Month Review
learningGoal: Reflect on progress across Month 3 and identify next steps.
microLesson: Reflection helps track emotional safety, routines, resilience, and parenting confidence.
activity: Write a 150‑word reflection on improvements and challenges this month.
